name: rolling-update
note: REL-10: both machines updated in turn. 'update' stops a machine cleanly (it cedes first when it holds the mandate, DET-05), keeps it out of service for 'ticks' periods, then reboots it through relais_node_init: it comes back empty and must be certified again (DEG-03, DEG-07). 'handover' is the voluntary cession of the holder (REL-09). Instants chosen so every step has the time to be certified: B out 30..50, certified again 54; A cedes 60, B holds 61, A certified 64; A out 80..100, certified again 104; B cedes 120, A holds 121, B certified 124. Not one tick is served by anything else than a fresh order.
